status: local preview only; domain and final five-page-per-pack selection are launch blockers
notes: Every image derives from an original local app asset or existing app screenshot.
Pig in mud replaces the optional flower choice because original Flowers line art needs separate alpha/background QA.
app-view-colouring.webp and app-view-packs.webp are device crops with marketing headlines removed; app-screen originals retained.
Intermediate app-screen-*.webp derivatives were removed after the header-free app-view-*.webp versions passed visual review.
Pencil icon derivatives now use the configured default AppIcon, visually verified against Apple public lookup version 1.3.7 on 2026-10-31. Previous app-icon.png remains until references are replaced.

The launch replaces app-icon.png with versioned pencil-app-icon.png, favicon-64.png and apple-touch-icon.png from the configured AppIcon default, verified against Apple’s live listing. Fonts are WOFF2; old task-created TTFs are not shipped.
